# Government, Politics, and Nationalism Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L19 - Government, Politics, and Nationalism

**Read:** Romans 13:1-7; Revelation 13:1-10

## Observe
- Record two direct observations from the passage.
- Identify relevant context and genre.

## Reason
- Test this big idea: Christians may honour governing authority without giving the state the worship or absolute allegiance owed to God.
- Label what is explicit text, synthesis/inference, framework position, or prudential application.

## Respond
- Name one faithful response that does not claim more than the evidence supports.

## Guardrail
- Distinguish respect for governing authorities from absolute allegiance; state obedience-to-God limits clearly.
purpose: Support the Government, Politics, and Nationalism lesson with an evidence-based claim audit.
title: Government, Politics, and Nationalism Claim Audit
